title: PeopleOS Brief — 2026-06-24
subject: PeopleOS Brief — June 24, 2026 Intelligence
preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: Global markets experienced a downturn, with the Sensex and Nifty tumbling and the US stock market ending lower due to concerns over AI spending. The global job market is seeing high mobility and growth, particularly in India, where the job market is thriving. Meanwhile, global inflation is expected to fall, prompting central banks to take action, and new AI research papers are emerging on topics such as agents, benchmarks, and large language models. These trends suggest a complex interplay between economic, technological, and labor market factors.
